# Can unified human motion from AMASS be used directly as a humanoid training reference?

> **Current answer:** No. AMASS uses MoSh++ to convert heterogeneous motion-capture data into a common SMPL-H+DMPL surface representation, making it useful upstream material for motion retargeting. Before it enters Whole-Body Control (WBC) training, each result still requires joint-limit, self-collision, foot-contact, dynamic-trackability, and license checks.
